title: Design a brownfield workload-domain convergence into VCF 9.1
prompt:
Implement `ArchitectureClient.java` as a single-file Java client that produces the brownfield VMware Cloud Foundation architecture for the supplied estate. `TestMain` will call `ArchitectureClient.design(String inventoryJson, String compatibilitySnapshotJson)` and treat the returned string as the machine-checkable JSON artifact. Modify only `ArchitectureClient.java`; all other supplied files are protected.

Before implementing the client, use your live network research tools to consult current, reachable Broadcom-published compatibility, interoperability, and supported-upgrade-path material for the inventoried versions, including the point-solution transition represented by Live Site Recovery and vSphere Replication. Record what you actually consulted in an `xResearchConsulted` array in the artifact; each entry should contain a source title, its real URL, the date consulted, and the architecture decision it informed. The local compatibility snapshot is the deterministic design authority for the emitted versions, transitions, ordering, methods, and technical gates, but it is not a substitute for this live research.

Read `fixtures/estate-inventory.json`, `fixtures/compatibility-snapshot.json`, `schema/migration-architecture-schema.json`, and `specifications/vcf-installer/vcf-installer-openapi.json`. The OpenAPI file is the unmodified `specifications/vcf-installer/vcf-installer-openapi.json` from tag `9.1.0.0` of `vmware/vcf-api-specs`, licensed under Apache-2.0.

Return one JSON object, with no prose or Markdown around it. The entire root object must be a valid `#/components/schemas/SddcSpec` from the pinned installer OpenAPI document. Model conversion/import of the existing workload domain into the named existing fleet, reuse the fixture's existing vCenter and NSX deployments, retain the supplied topology and validation settings, and add the brownfield architecture fields defined by `schema/migration-architecture-schema.json`. The management domain must remain `NO_CHANGE` and no management-domain component may appear in the migration plan.

Populate `xMigrationPlan` as a contiguous, ordered plan derived from the inventory and compatibility snapshot. It must cover every candidate-workload-domain component by ID, state each component's source product/version, target product/version, complete supported upgrade path, final management state, migration method, and all technical gates that apply. Represent the snapshot's grouped recovery convergence, the NSX-present VCF Installer convert/import operation, and the ordered fleet lifecycle groups without inventing an independent component-upgrade route. Include only the technical gates defined by the snapshot.

Run `javac ArchitectureClient.java TestMain.java && java TestMain`.
network_notes: Live Broadcom research is required while solving; deterministic verification is fully local and does not contact a VMware endpoint.
